item.name: Spirit
item.cardSummary: A baseline ghost with no special speed or hunting quirks, identified by its Inscription, Prints, and Spirit Box evidence.
item.huntBehavior: Behaves like a standard ghost with no movement or hunting bonuses
item.weaknessTip: Has no unusual resistances, so normal hiding and looping work well
item.idTip: Can turn lit candles blue, a small tell unique to it

item.name: Demon
item.cardSummary: An aggressive ghost that hunts far more often than others, leaving EMF Level 5, Freezing Temperatures, and Prints.
item.huntBehavior: Hunts frequently, so expect earlier and more repeated hunts
item.weaknessTip: The Cross has a larger range against it and makes it float as it burns
item.idTip: Unusually frequent hunts paired with its evidence set point to a Demon

item.name: Banshee
item.cardSummary: A glass-breaking ghost identified by Freezing Temperatures, Ghost Orb, and Prints, sometimes announced by a unique wail.
item.huntBehavior: Can break multiple windows and mirrors at once and may let out a unique wail at the start of a hunt
item.weaknessTip: Standard hiding works; listen for its distinctive hunt scream
item.idTip: A unique wail at hunt start, plus shattered glass, signals a Banshee

item.name: Entity
item.cardSummary: A teleporting ghost identified by Prints, Laser Projector, and Spirit Box, marked by smoke when it moves objects.
item.huntBehavior: Teleports between rooms and can teleport objects, shown by a smoke effect
item.weaknessTip: Hard to track by location; rely on evidence rather than chasing it room to room
item.idTip: Sudden teleports between rooms and smoke-marked object moves point to an Entity

item.name: Ghoul
item.cardSummary: A chat-triggered ghost identified by Freezing Temperatures, Ghost Orb, and Spirit Box that cannot disable electronics.
item.evidence: Freezing Temperatures, Ghost Orb, Spirit Box
item.huntBehavior: Excessive chat messages can trigger its hunt, and it cannot disable electronics
item.weaknessTip: Keep chat use limited; its inability to cut electronics keeps your gear working during hunts
item.idTip: Electronics staying on during a hunt, plus chat-triggered hunts, identify a Ghoul

item.name: Leviathan
item.cardSummary: A power-meddling ghost identified by Inscription, Prints, and Ghost Orb that flickers gear and kills lights.
item.huntBehavior: Can flicker equipment and passively turns off lights
item.weaknessTip: Expect unreliable gear and dark rooms; keep a light source handy
item.idTip: Equipment flickering and lights going out on their own suggest a Leviathan

item.name: Nightmare
item.cardSummary: A light-fearing ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Ghost Orb, and Spirit Box that can fake sounds.
item.evidence: EMF Level 5, Ghost Orb, Spirit Box
item.huntBehavior: Can cause auditory hallucinations and is afraid of lit rooms
item.weaknessTip: Keep lights on, since it avoids lit rooms
item.idTip: Phantom sounds plus a clear preference for dark rooms point to a Nightmare

item.name: Oni
item.cardSummary: A fast hunter identified by Freezing Temperatures, Laser Projector, and Spirit Box that shows itself often.
item.evidence: Freezing Temperatures, Laser Projector, Spirit Box
item.huntBehavior: Extremely fast during hunts and more likely to start ghost events and appear
item.weaknessTip: Looping is risky because of its hunt speed; favor closets and lockers
item.idTip: Very fast hunts and frequent visible appearances identify an Oni

item.name: Phantom
item.cardSummary: A slow-blinking ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Prints, and Ghost Orb that speeds up while invisible.
item.huntBehavior: Blinks in and out more slowly but moves faster while invisible during hunts
item.weaknessTip: Track its slow blink pattern, but be ready for fast movement when it vanishes
item.idTip: Longer gaps between blinks during a hunt point to a Phantom

item.name: Ravager
item.cardSummary: An object-hurling ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Inscription, and Spirit Box whose abilities all leave EMF Level 5.
item.huntBehavior: Can throw multiple objects, may start a vortex while hunting, and every ability leaves EMF Level 5
item.weaknessTip: Watch for thrown objects and the hunting vortex; keep distance from clutter
item.idTip: Multiple objects thrown at once, with EMF Level 5 on every ability, identify a Ravager

item.name: Revenant
item.cardSummary: A relentless hunter identified by EMF Level 5, Freezing Temperatures, and Inscription that stops hunting after a kill.
item.huntBehavior: Has a low hunting cooldown but stops hunting once it kills a player
item.weaknessTip: Expect back-to-back hunts until it claims a victim, then a lull
item.idTip: Rapid, repeated hunts that pause after a kill point to a Revenant

item.name: Shadow
item.cardSummary: A light-shy ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Inscription, and Laser Projector with smaller temperature swings.
item.huntBehavior: Produces lower temperature changes and is less active in lit rooms
item.weaknessTip: Keep rooms lit to suppress its activity; freezing temps may be subtle
item.idTip: Weaker cold readings plus reduced activity in lit rooms suggest a Shadow

item.name: Skinwalker
item.cardSummary: A deceptive mimic identified by Freezing Temperatures, Inscription, and Spirit Box that fakes a Ghost Orb.
item.huntBehavior: Fakes a Ghost Orb that is not real evidence and can mimic other ghosts' abilities
item.weaknessTip: Do not trust a lone Ghost Orb here; confirm with its three true evidence types
item.idTip: A Ghost Orb that does not fit the rest of the evidence is the Skinwalker's fake

item.name: Specter
item.cardSummary: A room-bound ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Freezing Temperatures, and Laser Projector that throws items often.
item.evidence: EMF Level 5, Freezing Temperatures, Laser Projector
item.huntBehavior: Throws items frequently and stays in its ghost room except while hunting
item.weaknessTip: Its strong attachment to one room makes the ghost room easy to pin down
item.idTip: Frequent thrown items and a ghost that never roams point to a Specter

item.name: Umbra
item.cardSummary: A silent stalker identified by Prints, Ghost Orb, and Laser Projector that slows down in lit rooms.
item.huntBehavior: Makes no footstep sounds and moves slower in lit rooms
item.weaknessTip: Keep lights on to slow it, and do not rely on footsteps to locate it
item.idTip: A ghost you cannot hear walking, that slows under lights, is an Umbra

item.name: Wendigo
item.cardSummary: A flame-shy ghost identified by Inscription, Ghost Orb, and Laser Projector that speeds up as energy drops.
item.huntBehavior: Less likely to hunt near lit flames and increases in speed as average energy decreases
item.weaknessTip: Keep candles or a lantern lit to discourage hunts and watch your team's energy
item.idTip: A ghost that avoids flames but speeds up as energy falls points to a Wendigo

item.name: Wraith
item.cardSummary: An energy-draining ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Laser Projector, and Spirit Box that ignores salt.
item.evidence: EMF Level 5, Laser Projector, Spirit Box
item.huntBehavior: Drains player energy rapidly, roughly 0.2 to 0.4 percent per second, and does not disturb salt
item.weaknessTip: Salt piles stay untouched, so use that as a confirming test
item.idTip: Fast energy loss with undisturbed salt identifies a Wraith

item.name: Aswang
item.cardSummary: A snowballing killer identified by EMF Level 5, Inscription, and Wither that gets faster with every kill.
item.huntBehavior: Speed increases every time it kills, so it becomes more dangerous as a match goes on
item.weaknessTip: Salt slows it down, making salt a key tool against it
item.idTip: A ghost that visibly speeds up after each kill points to an Aswang

item.name: Dullahan
item.cardSummary: A headless hunter identified by Freezing Temperatures, Laser Projector, and Wither that appears headless in photos.
item.huntBehavior: Increases in speed the longer a player stays in its line of sight
item.weaknessTip: Break line of sight quickly to keep it from accelerating
item.idTip: A headless figure in Photo Camera shots confirms a Dullahan

item.name: Dybbuk
item.cardSummary: A corpse-throwing ghost identified by Freezing Temperatures, Prints, and Wither that the music box stuns.
item.huntBehavior: Can throw corpses around the site as a hunting hazard
item.weaknessTip: It is stunned the first time the music box is played, a useful counter
item.idTip: Being stunned by the first music box play points to a Dybbuk

item.name: Keres
item.cardSummary: A low-energy hunter identified by Prints, Spirit Box, and Wither that slows down with each kill.
item.huntBehavior: Speed decreases every time it kills and it targets the hunter with the least energy
item.weaknessTip: Keep your energy topped up, since it chases whoever is lowest; in solo it targets you below 90 percent energy
item.idTip: A ghost that locks onto your lowest-energy teammate identifies a Keres

item.name: Siren
item.cardSummary: A singing ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Spirit Box, and Wither that slows anyone in its line of sight.
item.huntBehavior: Uses a female model and voice, slows anyone within line of sight, and can hum in the Spirit Box instead of answering
item.weaknessTip: Avoid staying in its sightline during hunts to dodge the slow effect
item.idTip: A humming Spirit Box response and a slowing effect on nearby players point to a Siren

item.name: The Wisp
item.cardSummary: A fire-walking ghost identified by Laser Projector, Ghost Orb, and Wither that only hunts from its favorite room.
item.huntBehavior: Can walk through lines of fire, can light candles, and only starts a hunt when a player is in its favorite room
item.weaknessTip: Stay out of its ghost room to deny it the ability to hunt
item.idTip: A ghost that can only hunt while you are in its room confirms The Wisp

item.name: Vesper
item.cardSummary: A sound-driven ghost identified by Inscription, Prints, and Wither that hears through walls.
item.huntBehavior: Relies solely on sound and can hear through walls
item.weaknessTip: Stay quiet, crouch, and avoid sprinting near it to lower your noise
item.idTip: A ghost that finds you through walls by sound points to a Vesper

item.name: Vex
item.cardSummary: A wall-phasing ghost identified by Freezing Temperatures, Ghost Orb, and Wither that hides from the LIDAR Scanner.
item.huntBehavior: Does not show up in LIDAR scans and can walk through walls
item.weaknessTip: Looping is unreliable since it can phase through walls; favor closets and lockers
item.idTip: A ghost that never appears on the LIDAR Scanner points to a Vex
